observations: Photo 0 shows a pink plastic case open, revealing a keyboard with 36 keys (12 black, 24 white) inside. The keys have colorful stickers (red, yellow, green, blue, purple, orange) and a white flexible hose with a black connector. The case has a handle and a small window.
Photo 1 shows the closed pink case with 'YAMAHA' embossed on the side. The case appears worn with scuffs and dirt. It is placed on a cluttered surface with boxes and other items.

Photo 2 shows a white plastic case with 'YAMAHA' embossed on the side, placed on top of a keyboard. The keyboard has 36 keys (12 black, 24 white) and is partially visible. The white case appears to be a separate item, possibly a cover or stand, not part of the keyboard itself.
The keyboard in photo 0 appears to be a 36-key model, likely a beginner or children's keyboard, given the colorful stickers and size. The pink case is likely a carrying case for this keyboard.
The white case in photo 2 is not part of the keyboard; it is a separate item, possibly a stand or cover, and is not visible in the other photos.
